    targets = torch.zeros(4096, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)

    logits[:, 1:] = 0.0   # Other classes neutral

    thread_255_indices = [255 + b * 256 for b in range(16)]

        logits[idx, 0] = -500.0   # Target class has very low logit
        logits[idx, 1:] = 0.0     # Other classes neutral
        # Loss for these samples ≈ 500 + log(1 + 9) ≈ 502
    
    # Expected mean ≈ (16 * 502 + 4080 * ~0) / 4096 ≈ 1.96
    # Any corruption at shared[255] would cause significant deviation
